encounter_rewrites.title: The Ghostly Guest
encounter_rewrites.body: Macbeth sits at his feast, but the silence is heavy. He sees a specter that no one else can see. It is not just a ghost; it is the weight of his own blood on his conscience. The nobles around him toast to his health, unaware that their king is already dead inside. The candlelight flickers, casting long shadows that seem to dance with the phantom he alone perceives in this moment of terrifying clarity and isolation.
reaction_rewrites: The silence stretches out like a physical weight, pressing against my chest as I realize the feast has become a funeral for my own soul.
Macbeth's voice cracks, trembling with a fear that he cannot name to his loyal lords who stand ready to defend him from any threat.

encounter_rewrites.title: The Field of Dunsinane
encounter_rewrites.body: Arrows fly like rain, but the ground beneath Macbeth's feet is turning red. He fights with a desperation that borders on madness, knowing that every blow he lands brings him closer to the end. The Scottish earth drinks his blood as the crown slips from his grasp. The battle rages around him, a chaotic storm of steel and fury where the only certainty is the inevitable approach of doom for the usurper.
reaction_rewrites: Macduff charges forward, his sword gleaming in the grey light of a dying day, determined to cut down the tyrant who has stolen their future.
